_comment: RESOLVED placement — gen-opus-1. Every module labeled; G2/G12/G13 resolved and modeled. A1 must PASS this. The _splits block models the G2 debug_overlay split (sink stays vision; run_* CLI runners -> new ed_core.cv_debug_cli) and the G12 step-table split (domain step modules register into a core-owned merged STEP_REGISTRY; the interpreter/cli read the core registry module, never a domain step module).

ed_autojump.vision.debug_overlay._why: Sink (ScreenToOverlay/CvDebugSink/set_debug_sink/get_debug_sink, lines 1-207) imports NOTHING in-workspace -> stays ed-vision as a true leaf. Runners (run_calibration/run_navpanel_overlay/run_cv_debug, lines 208+) carry ALL upward edges (..overlay) and the capture back-arm -> move to ed_core.cv_debug_cli. Kills both the VISION-IMPORTS violation and the vision.debug_overlay<->vision.capture cycle. capture->get_debug_sink stays a downward intra-vision edge.

ed_autojump.flow.steps._why: G12 seam. STEP_REGISTRY + INPUT_EXCLUSIVE_ACTIONS become a CORE-owned merged table (ed_core.flow.step_registry, surface #3). The interpreter (core) and cli (core) read the MERGED registry from core, NOT from any domain step module. Domain step modules (jump/dock in ed-autojump, body_tour in ed-explore) self-register their names INTO this core table at import/activation. redirect_incoming proves interpreter+cli now point at the core registry, not the domain step module — killing the two core->domain edges G12 flagged.

ed_autojump.flow.dispatcher._why: D3 dispatcher split. The ENGINE half (_TailHub, world-state latches, _apply_state/_record_event_time, _poll_status/_fresh_status/_navroute_state, heat watchdog, _run/_make_context/preemption/exclusive-input, the registry+active-set router shell) stays in ed_core.flow.dispatcher and keeps only the core edges (flow.context/interpreter/model). The JUMP CLASSIFIER + ROUTES half (_maybe_startup ladder, dispatch table, dispatch_route_complete, _is_route_complete, _resolve_final_waypoint, _is_parked_terminal) becomes ed_autojump.flow.boot_routes, which carries the domain edges (fsd.scoops for scoop math, the deferred .steps import for _destination_is_local_star/_dest_is_named_station — G10, now an intra-ed-autojump edge). boot_routes registers its classifier rules (surface #1) and event routes (surface #2) into the core router shell. No core->domain edge remains.
